routes.name: Your GP surgery
routes.description: For health concerns that are not urgent, and to book or change an appointment.

routes.name: A pharmacy
routes.description: Pharmacists can talk to you about your medicines and help with many everyday health problems, often without an appointment.

routes.name: NHS 111
routes.description: If you need help quickly but it is not an emergency. Free, any time, day or night.
Only in an emergency, when someone is seriously ill or hurt, or their life is at risk.

routes.name: Samaritans
routes.description: If you are finding things hard to cope with, you can talk to someone for free, any time, day or night.
